hypotheses.justification: Already follows from hcoeff 0: 0 ≤ ‖g.coeff 0 - f.coeff 0‖ < ε. Recover hε with this inequality and use the existing proof; ε ≤ 0 is impossible.

In the source of the root-continuity lemma, reference monicity is used only to show that a reference root forces positive degree. Instead, hfsep.ne_zero and Polynomial.natDegree_pos_of_aeval_root give positive degree. Reproduce the continuity estimate with this replacement, then retain the Krasner argument unchanged. Nonzero constants have no roots, so their case is vacuous; zero is excluded by separability.

Split on degree equality and use the existing proof when equal. Otherwise, Monic.coeff_natDegree and coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt show that the coefficient difference at the larger degree has norm 1, hence hcoeff gives 1 < ε. Real.one_le_rpow then shows the radius in hbound is at least ‖x‖. For each reference root x, hbound therefore supplies Krasner's condition with y = 0. Separability and minimal-polynomial splitting follow exactly as in the existing rootwise Krasner lemma. Thus x belongs to K₀⟮0⟯ = ⊥ by IntermediateField.adjoin_zero, proving the desired inclusion. Empty root sets, including degree zero, are vacuous.
